rule.title: Use or Distribution of Common Pricing Algorithm in Restraint of Trade
rule.requirement: A person is prohibited from using or distributing a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, combination in the form of a trust, or conspiracy to restrain trade or commerce.
rule.exemptions: The term person does not include the end consumer of a product or service. [Business and Professions Code § 16729(d)(5)]
rule.interaction: Nothing in this section shall impair or limit the applicability of antitrust laws.

rule.title: Coercion to Adopt Recommendations of Common Pricing Algorithm
rule.requirement: A person is prohibited from using or distributing a common pricing algorithm if that person coerces another person to set or adopt a recommended price or commercial term recommended by the common pricing algorithm for the same or similar products or services in California.
rule.exemptions: The term person does not include the end consumer of a product or service. [Business and Professions Code § 16729(d)(5)]
rule.interaction: Nothing in this section shall impair or limit the applicability of antitrust laws.
